## `purchase_completed`

An order was paid for. Send it from the backend, where the payment result is known.

**Sources:** browser, server · **Version:** 1

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `order.currency` | string | yes | pattern `^[A-Z]{3}$` |
| `order.id` | string | yes |  |
